parameters.content:
## Lead Intake & CRM (Chakra 9)

### Flow:
1. Receive lead via webhook (form, DM automation, WhatsApp)
2. Normalize data structure
3. AI qualification (score, extract details)
4. Save to database
5. Hot lead? → Slack notification
6. Prepare auto-response

### Integration Points:
- WhatsApp webhook (from main app)
- Instagram DM automation (ManyChat/etc)
- Website forms
- TikTok lead capture
